headline: Limit Instagram from using your data for AI and ads with new privacy controls
summary: Meta is rolling out expanded 'Activity from other businesses' controls, allowing users to prevent external data from personalizing ads, Feed content, and AI responses.
details: Instagram's ad personalization can feel 'telepathic' because businesses share your activity from outside the app with Meta. While Meta denies using your microphone, this data significantly influences the ads and content you see.

Meta is introducing a new 'Activity from other businesses' control, replacing older settings. This feature, rolling out since July 2026, allows users to decide if information sent by other businesses can personalize ads, Feed content, and AI recommendations.

It's important to note that this control does not stop Instagram from collecting data on your in-app activity, searches, likes, or posts. It also won't prevent businesses from sending data to Meta; it only limits how Meta uses that specific external data for personalization.

To adjust this setting, navigate to your Instagram profile, tap the three-line menu, and open Accounts Center. Look for 'Activity from other businesses'. If not yet available, check 'Ad preferences > Ad settings > Activity information from ad partners' and choose the option to prevent personalization.

iPhone users can further restrict tracking by going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking and disabling Instagram's permission. This leverages Apple's 'Ask App Not to Track' feature, blocking cross-app and website tracking for advertising purposes.

On Android, users can review app permissions under Settings > Apps > Instagram > Permissions. Deny access to location, contacts, photos, videos, camera, and microphone if not needed. However, Meta may still estimate location via IP address and network data.

Contact syncing also requires a separate check. In Accounts Center > Your information and permissions > Upload contacts, turn off 'Connect contacts' for your Instagram account. You can also manage and delete previously uploaded contacts via Instagram.com, though deletion can take up to 90 days.

Meta also uses interactions with its AI features for content and ad personalization, a practice that began on December 16, 2025. While there's no specific setting to disable this for AI chats, users can type '/reset-ai' in a chat to delete that AI's conversation history and saved details.

headline_marked: [[DOJ investigating a16z]] for board seats in rival AI companies, VCs baffled
headline: DOJ investigating a16z for board seats in rival AI companies, VCs baffled
summary: A Bloomberg report reveals the Department of Justice is probing venture firm Andreessen Horowitz over alleged conflicts of interest from board seats in competing AI startups. VCs express surprise at the focus.
details: The Department of Justice is reportedly investigating venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) over concerns about board seats held in rival AI companies. This news, initially reported by Bloomberg, has left many VCs and industry observers puzzled.

The probe has reportedly been ongoing for nearly a year, having commenced under the Trump administration. This timeline is notable given a16z's historical ties and engagement with the Trump administration.

Industry experts question why this particular issue has become a priority for the DOJ, noting that conflicts can arise organically as startups evolve. Founders often dislike VCs on competitor boards, but the dynamic nature of tech investments complicates clear-cut cases.

Specific examples include Ben Horowitz's seat on the Databricks board and partner Martin Casado's on Fivetran. The rapid growth of the AI sector has led many portfolio companies to pivot or expand into competitive spaces, making such overlaps more common for large firms like a16z.

Some speculate that the DOJ may be using a16z as an 'example' to influence compliance among smaller venture capital firms. The investigation highlights the complexities of antitrust enforcement in the fast-paced tech investment landscape.
